Application Data.NAME: Sunnyvale Produce Market
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunnyvale Produce Market is a retail establishment specializing in the sale of fresh fruits and vegetables, catering to a diverse clientele that includes local residents, restaurants, schools, and catering companies. We maintain strict adherence to food safety protocols, ensuring all produce is stored at optimal temperatures and regularly inspected for quality. Our market features a clean, organized layout that emphasizes customer experience and product accessibility. We also implement robust inventory management systems to minimize spoilage and conduct thorough employee training on food handling and safety practices. Our location benefits from a secure environment with adequate surveillance measures in place, allowing us to effectively manage risks associated with theft and product safety. Additionally, we have established partnerships with local farms to ensure a reliable supply of high-quality produce while supporting the community.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Sunnyvale Organic Produce Co. - 456 Maple Ave, Sunnyvale, CA 94087-1245
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a refrigeration unit malfunction resulted in a loss of fresh produce valued at $2,500. The incident was promptly reported, and necessary repairs were made to the refrigeration system. The claim was settled successfully on April 15, 2023, and measures have been implemented to conduct more frequent equipment inspections to prevent similar occurrences in the future. Additionally, on June 5, 2022, minor theft of $1,500 worth of inventory was reported. The store has since enhanced its security measures, including the installation of additional surveillance cameras. Both incidents are now marked as resolved.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe with UL Certification
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Enhanced security measures including 24/7 surveillance cameras, motion-sensor lighting, and regular security patrols.
